# Beagle

> Beagle is a vanilla Agent Skills repository: 82 framework-aware code review, planning, documentation, testing, and architectural analysis skills for any compatible coding agent. Skills cover Python, Go, Rust, Elixir, React/TypeScript, and iOS/Swift.

Skills follow the [Agent Skills specification](https://agentskills.io/specification) and live in flat `skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md` directories. Compatible coding agents load them automatically or by name (for example `review-python`). Install for any compatible agent with `npx skills add existential-birds/beagle` (or a single skill via `--skill <name>`).

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/existential-birds/beagle/blob/main/README.md): Overview, `npx skills add` installation, and 10-domain summary.
- [Skill catalog](https://github.com/existential-birds/beagle/blob/main/SKILLS.md): All 82 skills grouped into 10 domains with descriptions and direct `SKILL.md` links.
- [Agent & contributor guide](https://github.com/existential-birds/beagle/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Flat `skills/` layout, validation via `./scripts/check-portability.sh`, and authoring conventions.

## Domains (82 Skills)

- [Core Review, PR Feedback & Skill Tooling](https://github.com/existential-birds/beagle/blob/main/SKILLS.md#core-review-pr-feedback--skill-tooling) (12): Plan and structural maintainability review, shared verification protocol, GitHub PR feedback fetch/triage/reply, LLM coding-artifact detection/verification/fixing, and Agent Skills authoring/PR review.
- [Analysis, Strategy & Planning](https://github.com/existential-birds/beagle/blob/main/SKILLS.md#analysis-strategy--planning) (12): PRFAQ concept filtering, spec brainstorming and gap resolution, spec-driven and no-spec TDD planning, MADR ADRs, 12-Factor Agents audits, strategy interviews/reviews, cited web and local-doc research, and LLM-as-judge implementation comparison.
- [Documentation & Writing Quality](https://github.com/existential-birds/beagle/blob/main/SKILLS.md#documentation--writing-quality) (3): Diataxis doc auditing and type-balance checks (`improve-doc`), AI-writing detection (`review-ai-writing`), and safe/risky humanization (`humanize-beagle`).
- [End-to-End Testing](https://github.com/existential-birds/beagle/blob/main/SKILLS.md#end-to-end-testing) (2): Stack-aware E2E YAML test plan generation and stop-on-first-failure execution (`gen-test-plan`, `run-test-plan`).
- [Python](https://github.com/existential-birds/beagle/blob/main/SKILLS.md#python) (5): Backend code review across Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.0, PostgreSQL, and pytest.
- [Frontend (React & TypeScript)](https://github.com/existential-birds/beagle/blob/main/SKILLS.md#frontend-react--typescript) (10): Frontend review and guidance for React 19, React Router v7, `@xyflow/react` v12/v13, shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS v4, Zustand v5, Vitest v4, plus legacy Remix v2 maintenance review.
- [Go](https://github.com/existential-birds/beagle/blob/main/SKILLS.md#go) (9): Go backend and TUI code review, `net/http` architecture, persistence, BubbleTea v1/v2, Wish SSH, and Prometheus instrumentation.
- [Rust](https://github.com/existential-birds/beagle/blob/main/SKILLS.md#rust) (10): Rust Edition 2024 code review and best practices, tokio, axum, sqlx, serde, FFI, and macros.
- [Elixir & Phoenix](https://github.com/existential-birds/beagle/blob/main/SKILLS.md#elixir--phoenix) (8): Elixir/Phoenix 1.8 review, LiveView, ExUnit, BEAM performance and security, ExDoc writing, and ExDoc configuration.
- [iOS & Swift](https://github.com/existential-birds/beagle/blob/main/SKILLS.md#ios--swift) (11): iOS/Swift 6.2 review, SwiftUI, SwiftData, Swift Testing, animations, App Intents, CloudKit, HealthKit, WidgetKit, and watchOS.

## Optional

- [Agent Skills specification](https://agentskills.io/specification): The open spec these skills implement.
- [skills CLI](https://skills.sh/docs/cli): Install skills into any compatible agent.
- [Amelia](https://github.com/existential-birds/amelia): Agent-based workflows that pair with beagle.
- [Daydream](https://github.com/existential-birds/daydream): Automated review-fix-test loops that pair with beagle.
